stem: Two plants receive the same total irrigation volume but show different root-zone moisture patterns. What should be evaluated before assuming the plants have equivalent water availability?
choices: Delivery method, moisture distribution, substrate properties and plant establishment
Only the color of the leaves at the top of the canopy
Only the manufacturer's name on the irrigation system
rationale: Equivalent irrigation volume does not guarantee equivalent root-zone conditions; distribution, substrate and delivery characteristics affect water availability and use.
